name: campaign_checkpoint
description: Validate phase-aware WAIT checkpoint actions and enforce blocking check/profile selection rules.

decision.description: Human/agent WAIT checkpoint decision to validate.

action.description: Requested checkpoint action. Falls back to 'revise' if unknown or if validation otherwise fails.

feedback.description: Feedback text; required when action is 'revise'.

profile.description: Checks profile name; required when action is 'run_checks'.

checks.description: Specific check names requested; must be a subset of the selected profile's checks when action is 'run_checks'.

attachedConfirmed.description: Whether an attached artifact/change was confirmed.

maxTurns.description: Override for max agent turns; must be positive if set.

maxBudgetUsd.description: Override for USD budget ceiling; must be positive if set.

profiles.description: Profile name overrides to merge in, used when action is 'set_profiles'.

profile.description: Fallback checks profile name used when decision.profile is not set.

repoPath.description: Absolute path to the repo checkout, used to load the checks config and resolve the selected profile's allowed checks.

configPath.description: Path (relative to repoPath) to the checks configuration file.

phase.description: Campaign phase name, echoed back on the result.

maxTurns.description: Fallback max agent turns used when the decision does not set one.

maxBudgetUsd.description: Fallback USD budget ceiling used when the decision does not set one.

profiles.description: Current map of profile assignments, echoed back (and updated when action is 'set_profiles').

blockingPassed.description: Explicit override for whether blocking checks passed; wins over the individual blocking* signals below.

blockingStatus.description: Status string of the blocking phase; must equal 'success' for blocking to be considered passed.

blockingValid.description: Truthy/falsy validity flag from the blocking phase.

blockingIntegrated.description: Truthy/falsy integration flag from the blocking phase.

valid.description: True when the checkpoint decision had no validation errors.

errors.description: Validation failures, e.g. missing feedback, unmet blocking checks, unknown checks.

action.description: Resolved action; forced to 'revise' when validation errors occurred.

requestedAction.description: The action originally requested, before any forced fallback to 'revise'.

phase.description: Campaign phase name, echoed from input.

feedback.description: Feedback text; falls back to a semicolon-joined list of errors when action was forced to 'revise'.

profile.description: Checks profile name from the decision.

checks.description: Requested check names from the decision.

attachedConfirmed.description: Whether an attached artifact/change was confirmed.

maxTurns.description: Resolved max agent turns (decision override, else input fallback, else 500).

maxBudgetUsd.description: Resolved USD budget ceiling (decision override, else input fallback, else 50.0).

profiles.description: Resolved profile assignments; updated with the decision's profiles when action is 'set_profiles'.

outcome.description: 'incomplete' when the resolved action is 'stop', otherwise 'running'.
